name: Richmond Favourites 2023

venue.name: [Kwantlen Polytechnic University - Richmond](https://www.kpu.ca/richmond)
venue.details: Main Building on the 2nd Floor - Room 2550A

information: *Review all tabs on this website.* Competitors are only allowed to register for at most **(4)** events. Registrants with **more than 4** events selected after **December 31st 11:59pm PST** will be defaulted to only 3x3. Check the "**Favourites**" tab to see which events can qualify for a second round and for more details. **Event durations are tentative!** They may change depending on the number of competitors in events. Competitors are recommended to bring only 1 guest due to the venue capacity. Spectators can attend for free. Masks are optional and we will not be checking vaccination status. **Please be aware that there is a possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed. We may run behind or ahead depending on how the schedule goes - try to arrive at least **25** minutes prior to your competing/volunteering events. Join our [Facebook Group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494) to discuss cubing and hear about more event like these! To get updates about Canadian competitions, fill out this form from [Speedcubing Canada](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) mailing list to be notified about these events!
